patch.summary: Zoho CRM cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Zoho CRM pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Zoho CRM cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Zoho CRM against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (forecasting (Professional, Enterprise, Ultimate)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB and mid-market sales teams needing affordable multi-edition CRM requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
